familie.tittel: Family meal plan: seven dinners and a grocery list
familie.beskrivelse: Seven dinners most kids will eat, where two of them build on the night before. With links to the recipes, leftovers planned in, and one grocery list by aisle.
familie.ingress: Seven dinners most kids eat, set up so Monday and Thursday cook ahead for Wednesday and Saturday.
familie.vinkel: The week is built on two batches that each feed two dinners. Monday’s chicken thighs become quesadillas on Wednesday, and Thursday’s meat sauce becomes lasagna on Saturday. Tortillas, cheese and canned tomatoes show up in several dishes, so the list stays short.
faq: How do I get my kids to eat the meal plan?

The week has dinners many kids already know: chicken, tacos, quesadillas, spaghetti, pizza and lasagna. Taco night lets everyone build their own plate. Swap any day for a dinner you know your kids like, and move the rest of the list with it.
Can I switch the days around?
Yes, but keep the gap between a dish and the leftovers it makes. The chicken has to come before the quesadillas, and the meat sauce before the lasagna.

billig.tittel: Budget meal plan: seven dinners that use everything
billig.beskrivelse: Seven affordable dinners built on chicken, beans, eggs and pasta, where two batches each become two dinners. With links to the recipes and one grocery list.
billig.ingress: Seven dinners from ingredients that tend to be affordable, set up so little goes to waste.
billig.vinkel: We list no prices, because prices change by store and by week. The week stays lean another way: the chicken and the chili are cooked once and eaten twice, and flour, eggs and milk cover several dinners.
faq: Why are there no prices on the budget meal plan?
Prices change from store to store and from week to week, and we have no open source for what each dinner costs. Instead, the week is set up so you buy fewer items and throw less away.
What makes the week cheaper?
Two dinners are made from leftovers of an earlier day, and several items return from dish to dish. Pancakes and tuna noodle casserole rest on pantry basics.

dager.hvorfor: A whole chicken gives more meat than the same number of breasts. It roasts while you do something else.

dager.hvorfor: Breakfast for dinner is quick, and it runs on pantry basics.

vegetar.tittel: Vegetarian meal plan: seven dinners without meat or fish
vegetar.beskrivelse: Seven vegetarian dinners built on beans, eggs, pasta and vegetables. Monday’s chili fills quesadillas on Wednesday. With recipe links and one grocery list.
vegetar.ingress: Seven dinners without meat or fish, with beans, eggs and cheese, and one pot that becomes two dinners.
vegetar.vinkel: Monday’s chili is made in a double batch and fills quesadillas on Wednesday. The rest of the week moves between a stir-fry, soup, pizza, lasagna and a frittata, so no two nights look alike.
faq: Is there meat or fish in any of the dinners?
No. None of the seven recipes lists meat or fish, and where broth is used it is vegetable broth. If you are strict about cheese, check the cheeses yourself.
Can I switch the days around?
Yes, but use Monday’s chili by Wednesday. The other days can move freely.

for-en.tittel: Meal plan for one: seven dinners with little waste
for-en.beskrivelse: Seven dinners for one person. One dinner becomes two, one goes in the freezer, and the rest scale down to a single serving. With links to the recipes.
for-en.ingress: Seven dinners for one, set up so you shop once and do not end up with half-used packages.
for-en.vinkel: Recipes are often written for four. This week you scale most of them down to one serving. On Wednesday you make the whole pot of meat sauce and freeze the servings you do not eat. On Thursday you bake extra chicken for Friday’s stir-fry, and on Sunday you take a serving of sauce out of the freezer.
faq: How do I scale a recipe down to one serving?
Divide the amounts by the number of servings the recipe makes. In Matlyst you change the number of servings on the recipe, and the amounts are recalculated. The math is linear, so season to taste.
How long can the meat sauce stay in the freezer?
USDA says leftovers can be frozen for {fryser}. Freeze what you will not eat soon.

husmannskost.tittel: Comfort food meal plan: seven classic dinners
husmannskost.beskrivelse: Meat loaf, chicken pot pie, macaroni and cheese, oven-fried fish, pot roast and sandwiches. Seven classic dinners with recipe links and a grocery list.
husmannskost.ingress: Seven classic American dinners, set up so Monday’s meat loaf becomes Wednesday’s sandwiches and Saturday’s roast becomes Sunday’s.
husmannskost.vinkel: Comfort food rests on staples that keep, which makes the week easy to plan. Monday’s meat loaf is baked whole, and the part you set aside becomes sandwiches on Wednesday. Saturday’s roast is cooked the same way and feeds Sunday’s sandwiches.
faq: What counts as comfort food?
Familiar home cooking made from plain ingredients, like meat loaf, chicken pot pie, macaroni and cheese and pot roast. The week here sticks to dishes like that.
Can I use leftover meat loaf in other dishes?
Yes. Sliced meat loaf works in sandwiches, which is how this week uses it. Use it by Wednesday, as this plan does.
